messages:
ana: Heads up — planning to onboard cobalt-3b-v2 into the model catalog Tue 2026-03-24 08:00 UTC.
ana: It's an accuracy-optimized variant with a new quant config; we'll keep cobalt-3b-v1 as a cost-favorite fallback.
ana: Requesting: deploy owner, smoke test owners, rollback lead, and a quick code-review for the catalog PR.
ryan: I can own the deploy window. I prefer 08:00 UTC — low traffic in EU/NA. Will monitor latency SLOs.
emily: I'll run the prompt set for QA smoke and check hallucination regressions. ETA: finish before Monday EOD.
samir: pinging @ryan for the infra PR: CI needs the new kernel flag in infra-config. small change.
ryan: saw that — will merge infra PR after a quick lint fix. @samir can you add the snippet to the PR so CI is green?
samir: done. CI passing locally, pushed fix. Tests look clean.
nana: Deploy plan outline:
1) push catalog entry + pin v2 as 'opt-accel' (no default traffic)
2) Canary 5% traffic via routing flag
3) Run smoke: latency/throughput, token-accuracy checks on prompt set
4) If green, swap pin to default for dedicated slot, then ramp

ana: Rollback: if latency p50 > 1.2x baseline OR any hallucination delta > 3% -> immediate rollback to v1. Ryan to execute rollback command.
ryan: Got it. Rollback command: `infra rollback --model cobalt-3b --to-version v1 --force` — will keep channel open.
qa-bot: Reminder: run prompt-set `cobalt_onboard_daily.json` with `--samples 100` and upload results to /evals/cobalt-v2/
emily: Starting smoke run now. Will post CI artifacts link when done.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for 2026-03-24T08:00:00Z. Notifying on-call.
ana: Quick code review needed on catalog PR: https://git.internal/redwood/models/pull/412 — 2 small comments.
samir: Reviewed, left suggestions. @ana can you confirm the metadata fields? we need `quant_profile: q8_0` in the catalog entry.
ana: Confirmed — adding `quant_profile: q8_0`. Also adding `routing_tags: ["opt-accel","safepin"]`.
ryan: Ops checklist: monitor logs `tail -f /var/logs/model-serving/cobalt-3b.log` and watch infra dashboard.
emily: Smoke artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/evals/cobalt-v2/smoke-20260322 — summary: latency +5%, accuracy +1.2%.
ana: That's within thresholds. Ryan, proceed with canary at 5% at deploy time. I'll stay on call for 90m.
ryan: Canary started. status: healthy after 15m. Moving to 25%.
emily: QA green on hallucinations. No new toxics detected on prompt set.
samir: infra metrics stable. GPU mem within expected envelope.
ryan: Rolling to 50% now.
ana: If all good at 50% we'll flip pin and announce.
deploy-bot: Canary complete. 50% sustained for 30m, no alerts.
ana: Flip pin scheduled. After flip, leave v1 pinned as fallback for immediate rollback.
ryan: Pin flipped to v2 in catalog. Traffic routing updated.
emily: Post-deploy checks: latency p50 +6%, p95 +9% (still under 1.2x), accuracy +1.3%.
nana: Closing out: PR merged, deploy done, docs updated. Thanks all :tada:
ryan: Nice work everyone :rocket:
qa-bot: CI artifacts archived to /evals/cobalt-v2/20260324
ana: Filing brief runbook note in Confluence: /confluence/eng-ml/cobalt-3b-v2-onboard
